trip.title: Across the city, without guesswork
trip.summary: A realistic transfer day with the journey details kept between destinations, where they belong.

items.title: Arrive at Gare du Nord
items.notes: Collect luggage before leaving the concourse.

items.instructions: Use the official rank outside rue de Dunkerque; show the hotel address to the driver.

items.title: Leave bags at Hôtel des Grands Boulevards

to.name: Musée d'Orsay entrance
to.address: 1 Rue de la Légion d'Honneur, Paris

items.instructions: Keep the same ticket through the transfer. Follow blue RER C signs at Invalides; the museum entrance is a five-minute riverside walk from Musée d'Orsay station.

segments.instructions: Walk to Richelieu–Drouot via rue du Faubourg Montmartre.

segments.notes: Leave at Invalides; do not exit the station.

segments.instructions: Use the riverside exit and the accessible museum entrance.

items.title: Musée d'Orsay timed entry
items.reservation: 11:15 timed entry · QR ticket in wallet
items.notes: The multi-segment journey above intentionally remains a transit leg, not four artificial activities.
